landing.heroSubtitle: Discover verified releases for GTA V / FiveM, Minecraft, ETS2, BeamNG, Assetto Corsa and more — one account, one library, zero clutter.
landing.noGamesYet: Our game catalog is being finalized. New titles land here first.
landing.noModsYet: The catalog is warming up. Creators are uploading — check back soon.
landing.premiumBannerDesc: Unlock the full premium library, member-only releases, Discord perks, and faster support when you need it.
landing.featuresTitle: What Xumari Modz does for you
landing.feature1Text: The app puts mods straight into the right game folder. No unzipping, no searching.
landing.feature2Text: Uploads are scanned for malware automatically. You see the result on every mod page.
landing.feature3Text: If a mod needs other files, we show them and fetch them for you on request.
landing.feature4Text: Every version stays available, with what changed listed right next to it.
landing.feature5Title: One account for web and app
landing.feature5Text: Library, favorites and purchases are the same everywhere.
landing.feature6Text: A share of Premium and purchases goes to the creators whose mods you use.
landing.faq1A: Subscribe to Premium or buy individual mods. Downloads use secure signed links that expire after a few minutes to protect creators.
landing.faq2A: GTA V / FiveM, Minecraft, Euro Truck Simulator 2, BeamNG.drive, and Assetto Corsa at launch. New games are added by our team as the catalog grows.
landing.faq3A: Link Discord via OAuth during login or from your dashboard. Premium and Creator roles sync automatically to our community server.
landing.faq4A: Apply from your dashboard once registered. Verified creators can publish mods, manage versions, and view download analytics.
